description: Does the projection contain the preference the task actually needs? One profile holding a belief on every dimension plus undifferentiated noise; each case is a natural request that turns on exactly one of them. Written before any intent-aware ranker existed, and frozen by content hash.
authoring_note: Tasks are phrased as a user would phrase them, without naming the dimension or its value. A case whose wording contains its own answer measures string matching, not retrieval.

profile.note: Noise sits at the confidence a repeated behavioural observation earns, which is slightly above what a single explicit statement decays to. That is the whole difficulty: the target belief is real and relevant and still loses on confidence alone.
